title: Recent WhatsApp acknowledgement creates a duplicate dialog
original_report: A customer replied Thank you immediately after an order clarification was completed, but Riderra created a new unlinked dialog instead of keeping the response in the order conversation.
discovery_scope: Production chat tasks and messages for booking 787761543
expected: A short acknowledgement from the same phone immediately after closure remains in the recently closed order dialog and creates no outbound draft.
actual: The closed task was excluded from phone matching, so Riderra created an inbound_inquiry with an unrelated pending AI draft.
environment: Node.js Riderra service, disposable local PostgreSQL 15 database, production verification after deployment
reproduction: The smoke creates one closed order dialog with a recently delivered outbound WhatsApp message, posts Thank you from the same number without taskId, and asserts task identity, closed state, ack classification, and absence of a split inquiry or draft.
failure_signal: The pre-fix API returned the id of a newly created inbound inquiry instead of the recently closed order task.
root_cause: Phone-based inbound routing filtered out every task in state closed before considering that a short acknowledgement can arrive seconds after the final Riderra message.
fix_summary: Recognize a narrow set of standalone acknowledgements, attach one to the unique recently closed WhatsApp order dialog from the same phone within 24 hours, keep the dialog closed, and skip response-draft generation.
why_causal: The new fallback runs exactly where the active-task lookup previously failed and selects the proven original task before inquiry creation.

reproduction_files.summary: Approved red-to-green regression fixture for a recently closed WhatsApp order dialog.

fix_files.summary: Approved acknowledgement recognition, recent closed-task routing, and no-draft terminal handling.

checks.name: Regression smoke
checks.detail: The same assertion failed before the fix and passed afterward in a disposable database.

checks.name: Nuxt production build
checks.detail: All static routes generated successfully; only pre-existing dependency and bundle-size warnings remained.

checks.name: Production repair
checks.detail: Thank you is now in booking 787761543; the duplicate task and its open OpsTask were removed, and the unsent draft was rejected.

limitations: The fallback applies only to a standalone acknowledgement, exactly one recent closed order task for the phone, and a 24-hour window.
residual_risks: An ambiguous phone with multiple recent closed order dialogs remains an inbound inquiry for manual linking instead of being guessed.
notes: No customer message was sent during diagnosis, repair, or verification.
The pre-existing generic bug-reproducer report files were left untouched because they document a separate WhatsApp image issue.
